baseline: Browser decode then JavaScript materialized matrix PCM then OfflineAudioContext render
candidate: Same browser decode then ChannelSplitter/Gain/ChannelMerger graph directly rendered
correctness: Every output sample versus independently materialized float matrix reference, maxabs<=1e-7; wrong channel order and stale-source-without-stop must differ; actual old source stop/disconnect and graph cleanup; no speaker-semantic inference
sampling: Correctness before timing; one warmup and7 alternating pairs per profile; complete cold context creation, decode, matrix or graph setup, offline rendering, node disconnect and references release. OS/browser caches warm; immutable input fetch excluded equally
threshold: Candidate median complete wall<=1.10baseline; retained extra transformed PCM payload reported separately, not total memory; no CPU/energy claim
